Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (May 18, 2023) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotation, Ariba Document Number 3320337449. Description: For the non-exclusive supply and delivery of Environmental Services related to Designated Substances and Hazardous Material Surveys / Assessments, indoor air quality investigations, mould investigations, and soil sampling and analysis, for a period of one (1) year from the date of award, with the option to renew the contracts for four (4) additional separate one (1) year periods. Should the option(s) be exercised, then the General Manager, Toronto Water Division will request the Chief Procurement Officer to process the renewals under the same terms and conditions.
